# Bharat Properties

> Premier Real Estate Consultancy in North India

Bharat Properties is an established real estate consultancy with regional offices in Kurukshetra (Haryana) and Mohali (Punjab). We provide advisory, on-ground site visits, property transactions, and documentation assistance for residential plots, luxury apartments, builder floors, and commercial developments.

## Regional Offices
- Kurukshetra (HQ): Shop No 166, Sector 3 Market, Kurukshetra, Haryana 136118 (Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/Yfr1YSYGP1mrLbNR6)
- Mohali Branch: PR 7, Airport Road, Mohali, Punjab (Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/SrXsJrh5L23qLEtM6)
